newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CNA, Heaven mull franchise deal.
newsitem.headline: CNA, Heaven mull franchise deal.

text.p: South Africa's CNA Gallo Ltd will take a 25 percent stake in Sweets from Heaven Ltd if a franchise deal, which the two retailers are currently evaulating, is launched, they said on Sunday.
The deal would see Heaven confectionary stores being introduced in the majority of CNA's 300 retail outlets, as well as in Nu Metro cinema complexes nationwide.
The deal is expected to be sealed in January next year, with the price of the acquisition only being announced if and when it is finally implemented, the parties said in a statement.
However, Investec Merchant Bank said the deal envisaged a "capital injection and the acquisition of shares".

The agreement is expected to enhance the trading performance of CNA's own confectionary division while "providing Heaven with a franchise opportunity to move into strategically well-located national sites", the two companies said.

Shares in Heaven have surged in the past week on speculation of such a tie-up following a cautionary announcement last Friday. Shares closed on Friday at a record high of 134 cents, up 14 cents or 12 percent on the week.
